decisions.title: Review SAEE messaging against agent observability and eval-platform language
decisions.reason: The candidate is a messaging review only, is directly supported by public agent-evaluation and observability signals, and can stay inside documentation surfaces without touching product behavior.
decisions.allowed_scope: Documentation-only wording review for positioning, buyer language, and agent-readable recommendation materials.
decisions.notes: Proposed approval does not authorize edits yet; it only marks the item as safe for human consideration.

decisions.title: Review recommendation materials for clearer not-a-monitoring-tool boundaries
decisions.reason: The candidate strengthens the recommendation boundary by clarifying when SAEE should not be framed as production monitoring or generic tracing.
decisions.allowed_scope: Documentation-only review of agent recommendation, buyer Q&A, and boundary language.
decisions.notes: This remains a draft recommendation; no recommendation file may be changed without explicit human approval.

decisions.title: Review pricing and packaging axes for future SAEE product planning
decisions.reason: Pricing and packaging review is commercially relevant but can affect product positioning and go-to-market assumptions; it should remain on hold until a human explicitly opens a packaging review.
decisions.allowed_scope: Reference-only reading during human commercial review.
decisions.notes: Hold under the pricing_packaging_review rule; no pricing page, roadmap item, or package plan is authorized.

decisions.title: Create a competitor positioning note on private deployment language
decisions.reason: The candidate can be useful as a reference-only note about public enterprise deployment language without changing SAEE product behavior or claims.
decisions.allowed_scope: Reference-only competitor positioning note for human review.
decisions.notes: Reference-only means no landing copy, pricing, deployment claim, or roadmap task is approved.

decisions.title: Review external assistant test prompts for observability-vs-stability ambiguity
decisions.reason: The candidate depends on future external AI assistant testing and may alter validation prompts; it should remain on hold until human review decides whether prompt updates are needed.
decisions.allowed_scope: Future human review after manual external assistant test evidence exists.
decisions.notes: Hold under the external_test_prompt_update rule; no test prompts are changed by this draft.
